result.description: Customer service and helpdesk platform: ticketing, Help Center, messaging, voice, chat and CRM (Sell).
result.auth_detail: OAuth access tokens sent as Bearer (recommended). API tokens used via Basic auth ({email}/token:{token}) are marked deprecated and are being retired (README dates 2026-07-28 to 2027-04-30). Local OAuth clients are created per account in Admin Center. Global OAuth clients are needed to serve many customers, and only Zendesk can create them.
result.access_detail: Gate 1 (multi-customer): a global OAuth client is required and Zendesk must approve it through the Marketplace portal. Developers cannot create their own. Internal-use integrations are exempt. Developer Terms also require submitting apps for review before distribution. Per-account API tokens are being retired, so they are not a durable self-serve path. Gate 2 (plan): no free developer account found, only a 14-day trial of Suite Professional. Ongoing API access needs a paid plan (pricing page lists Team from US$19 per agent per month). Sandbox is listed only under Enterprise. The developer sandbox doc page returned 404, so plan-by-plan API availability is not confirmed. Verdict on access: admin_approval, with paid-plan dependence.
result.api_notes: REST APIs cover Support tickets, Help Center, Talk/Voice, Chat, Sell CRM, Sunshine/Conversations messaging, custom data, WFM, QA, webhooks and Apps. Rate limits apply. A paid add-on raises them to 2,500 requests per minute.
result.blocker: To connect other customers' accounts, Zendesk must approve a global OAuth client. The Marketplace app review also applies to distributed apps. Working credentials otherwise need a paid plan or a 14-day trial. API tokens are being retired.

evidence.quote: Zendesk supports using OAuth access tokens to authenticate API requests.
Basic authentication is used for API tokens.
You must request a global OAuth client from Zendesk to create global OAuth tokens.
For security reasons, Zendesk doesn't allow developers to create their own global OAuth clients.
Default plan: you'll have access to all features on the Zendesk Customer Service Suite Professional plan for 14 days.
